Figure 3:Overview of StateWeaver.Active States support state planning, review-driven refinement, and reference supplementation, with confirmed results updating memory to preserve continuity across sets.
Hierarchical Collaboration organizes the chief director, executive directors, and set directors, connecting isolated execution contexts through hierarchical story and asset memory.

Figure 4:Long-range qualitative comparison.Rows show MovieAgent, ViMax, StoryEngine, ATAS, and StateWeaver at corresponding story moments.
StateWeaver preserves visual identity across shots and carries event-induced state changes into subsequent clips.

Table 1:Comprehensive long-video comparison across four benchmarks.ST-Bench, ViMax-Bench, and EntityBench use predefined storyboards, while DirectorBench uses autonomous planning. Overall is the pre-rounding macro-average of all metrics. Higher is better. Best and second-best results are bolded and underlined.
